label: Event
summary: A conference, wedding, launch, workshop or trip with a date, a venue, vendors and a budget. One schedule, one budget, written confirmations for every commitment.

first_phase.title: Scope, date, budget envelope, the list of decisions

questions.ask: What the event is, in one line, and for how many people.
The date, or the window if not fixed, and the place or city.
The budget envelope, with its currency, or 'not decided'.

phases.title: Scope, date, budget envelope, decisions list
Venue and vendors: shortlist, questions, written confirmations
Guest list, invitations prepared, replies tracked
The run-of-show: minute by minute, who does what
After: payments closed, thanks prepared, what to keep for next time
